tagline.en: Transatel's global eSIM, with a selectable IP country
tagline.zh: Transatel 的全球 eSIM，IP 归属地可自选

description.en: Ubigi is run by Transatel, an NTT Group company, which makes it an operator rather than a reseller. 200+ destinations, strongest in Europe and North America, and pay-as-you-go credit that does not expire between trips. It also ships preinstalled in cars from several manufacturers. The account side still feels like telecom software rather than a travel app.
description.zh: Ubigi 由 NTT 集团旗下的 Transatel 运营，是运营商而不是转售商。覆盖 200+ 目的地，欧洲与北美最强，按量付费的余额在两次行程之间不过期。它还被预装进多个品牌的车机。只是账号体系仍然像电信软件，不太像旅行 App。

details.en:
Ubigi's differentiator is telecom-industry depth: Transatel is a full MVNO operator inside the NTT Group, not a travel-tech startup, and it shows — Ubigi ships preinstalled in cars from Jaguar Land Rover, BMW and others, and its network agreements favour premium carriers in Europe and North America.

For travellers, the catalogue mixes day passes (from 500 MB / 1 day), 30-day bundles (1 GB to 50+ GB), regional Europe/USA/Asia packs, and monthly subscription plans (e.g. 10 GB/month recurring) aimed at frequent flyers and expat families — the subscription angle is rare among travel eSIM brands. Installation can start from the car dashboard or the Ubigi app/web account; the same account tops up across countries. Pricing sits in the middle of the pack: not the cheapest per GB, but the network quality in Europe (often multi-carrier) is consistently reported as excellent. Pay-as-you-go credit never expires, which suits occasional travellers who want a set-and-forget eSIM that stays valid between trips.
details.zh:
Ubigi 的差异化在电信行业纵深：Transatel 是 NTT 集团内的完整 MVNO 运营商，而非旅行科技创业公司——Ubigi 预装在捷豹路虎、宝马等多家车企的车机里，其网络协议在欧洲与北美倾向优质运营商。

面向旅行者的目录混合了日包（500 MB / 1 天起）、30 天流量包（1 GB 到 50+ GB）、欧洲/美国/亚洲区域包，以及面向常旅客与海外家庭的按月订阅（如 10 GB/月自动续费）——订阅制在旅行 eSIM 品牌中相当少见。

安装可从车机或 Ubigi App/网页账号开始，同一账号跨国续费通用。价格处于中游：每 GB 不是最便宜，但欧洲的网络质量（常为多运营商）口碑一贯出色。

按量付费余额永不过期，适合偶尔出行、希望 eSIM 在两次旅行之间一直可用的人。

bestFor.en: Frequent Europe or North America flyers, and anyone who wants credit that survives between trips instead of expiring.
bestFor.zh: 常飞欧洲或北美的人，以及希望余额能留到下次行程、不要过期的人。

en: Strong coverage in Europe and North America
zh: NTT 集团旗下公司运营
为常旅客提供订阅制套餐
欧洲与北美覆盖表现出色

plansNote.en: Ubigi's per-destination plan grid is large (day passes, 30-day bundles, regional and subscription tiers). Prices change per market — consult ubigi.com for live rates.
plansNote.zh: Ubigi 逐目的地套餐矩阵较大（日包、30 天包、区域包与订阅档）。价格随市场变动，以 ubigi.com 实时价为准。

en: A real operator (NTT/Transatel), so the routing is first-party
Pay-as-you-go credit carries over between trips
Monthly subscriptions work out cheaper for frequent flyers
Preinstalled in cars from Jaguar, BMW and others
zh: 真正的运营商（NTT/Transatel），线路是一手的
按量付费余额可以带到下次行程
高频出行按月订阅更划算
预装在捷豹、宝马等车机里

en: App and account flow feel like telecom software, not travel tech
Per-GB prices sit mid-pack; budget brands are cheaper
Day passes start at 500MB, thin for a heavy day
zh: App 和账号流程像电信软件，不像旅行产品
每 GB 价格中游，低价品牌更便宜
日包 500MB 起，重度使用一天不够

country.en: France (home-routed); selectable residence-country or regional IP via official IP-location feature
country.zh: 法国（归属地回传）；可在官方 IP 定位功能里改选居住国或区域 IP

note.en: Ubigi (Transatel/NTT, French) home-routes traffic so users typically get a French/European carrier IP; the official IP Location feature can present a residence-country or regional IP (France, US, Japan, etc.). IPs are carrier mobile-network IPs, not residential broadband.
note.zh: Ubigi（法国 Transatel/NTT）为 home-routing 架构，默认出口多为法国/欧洲运营商 IP；官方 IP Location 功能可选居住国或区域 IP（法、美、日等）。属于运营商移动网络 IP，非住宅宽带。
